expr: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /sign in|log in|submit/i.test(x.textContent || '')); if (!b) return 'no button'; b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

(() => { const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-expanded]')).find(b => (b.textContent||'').includes('Plugin(s) degraded')); if (!row) return 'no info row'; const before = row.getAttribute('aria-expanded'); row.click(); return 'clicked info row, before=' + before; })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText || ''; const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-expanded]')).find(b => (b.textContent||'').includes('Plugin(s) degraded')); return JSON.stringify({ detailVisible: t.includes('enabled but not usable'), ariaExpanded: row ? row.getAttribute('aria-expanded') : null }); })()

(() => { const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-expanded]')).find(b => (b.textContent||'').includes('Plugin(s) degraded')); if (!row) return 'gone'; row.click(); return 'collapsed'; })()
(() => { const t = document.body.innerText || ''; return 'detailHiddenAfterCollapse=' + !t.includes('enabled but not usable'); })()
